description: Safety-invariant and external-effect surfaces. A change to one of these paths (exact file, directory ending in /, or glob using *, ?, **, [...]) requires a linked decision record. check_decision_records.py verifies each path exists and each referenced record is accepted; check_decision_record_links.py requires an accepted, indexed record in the review receipt for any pull request that changes a protected path, including this manifest itself.

invariants.statement: Models return bounded candidates and advisory assessments; deterministic code owns planning, budgets, retries, termination, disposition, and effects.
Credentialed analysis reads immutable Git objects and does not execute pull-request code, hooks, tests, builds, or checked-out working trees.
Provider credentials are attached only to HTTPS or exact-loopback endpoints, with no redirects or URL-embedded credentials.
Review runs and the CLI create no live publication effect; only an explicitly authorized publication route may write externally.
Provider endpoints, models, accounts, and credentials come from trusted configuration; no new provider or automatic fallback is introduced.
The installed package keeps one review orchestrator and respects the recorded post-CA-2 source-line budget.
No production-quality or replacement claim is made without independent quality evidence; a successful publication or transport run is not quality evidence.
